kind: v30 semantics repair: g^k pool arm, key-collision kappa, cap/abort bound, independent audit

gap_cap.kind: v30 CAP/ABORT policy (replaces v29's expected-maximum tail)
gap_cap.law: consecutive H-primes near q are spaced mu(q) = d*ln q because an integer near q lies in the index-d subgroup (d = 2^20) with density 1/d and is prime with density 1/ln q; at the production walk band q_w ~ 2^76 this gives mu = 2^20*ln(2^76) = 2^25.719
gap_cap.support_bound: support <= K_max/2 = 2^30 even-gap entries per base, DETERMINISTIC: the table is truncated at K_max, so the row is a function of the cap and not of any expectation
gap_cap.policy: cap + bounded fallback + abort: (a) at most K_max/2 entries per base are ever built; (b) a realised gap above K_max is served by the priced fallback (a 32-doubling small-scalar multiple of a_iP0, 62 group ops), and at most M_max = 4 such entries are charged per trail; (c) a trail needing a (M_max+1)-th aborts and contributes nothing (success 0, work charged)
gap_cap.success_debit: P(abort) = P(Poisson(0.01154) > 4) = 1.690e-12 = 2^-39.11; the crown CP-lo 0.396298 x (1 - 2^-39.11) = 0.396298, i.e. the debit is 2^-39.11, far below the 0.0063 margin over the 0.39 floor

cap_demo.note: the cap is IMPLEMENTED and it FIRES. With the cap set at the fixture's own p99 trail-max gap (8.79 mu_fixture) the census aborts 3.8542% of trails, against 65.2% predicted by the UNSUPPRESSED exponential gap law: the measured tail is 16.9x LIGHTER than the law we charge, so charging the unsuppressed law at the production cap is conservative. The abort counter is therefore a measurement, not a story

pool_arm.role: CONFIRMATORY arm (not the load-bearing one: the crown distribution arm and the structured ladder clear the 0.39 floor; this arm tests that the PRODUCTION BASE LAW does not move q)
pool_arm.design: SAME binary, SAME walk object, SAME counters as the crown arm; the only difference is draw_base: a = g^k with k uniform in [1,2^18), so log_g(a) = k is small BY CONSTRUCTION (the production pool law: a 97-bit integer exponent inside a 2^38.000-order group), and span+walk_band = 40 < 41 keeps a_i*w_k an exact no-wrap product

control.note: identical geometry/seed family with full-support bases: the base law is the only difference from the pool arm

kappa.statistic: census object counts EXACT colliding PAIRS sum_b C(m_b,2) on the TRUNCATED KEY (the key the store indexes), per walk; v29 counted N - #distinct full residues, which is a multiplicity-1 statistic and not what the store compares
kappa.key_bits_note: production keys are the 168-bit truncated even-y key over |H| = 2^234.857, i.e. 71.5% of the residue bits survive; the fixture's density-matched truncation is 20 of 38 bits = 52.6%
kappa.charged_rule: charged = max(carried envelope 1.231, measured per-walk KEY-collision max 4.254437): the carried envelope is RETAINED when the measurement is below it, so no carried row is re-priced downward on the strength of a fixture run
